I am a third year photographic storytelling student at Ball State University in Muncie, Indiana. My experience spans from portraiture through video journalism. I am an active member of the National Press Photographers Association, including serving as an executive officer on the board, a regular attendee to the Atlanta Photojournalism Seminar, and mission-driven documentarian.

My experience includes service as a Multimedia Editor at the Ball State Daily News, travelling to Washington, D.C., Mexico, and France, and surviving tempermental midwestern weather.

I coded this website by hand using 11ty, lightboxjs3, flexboxgrid.css
